outcome: Laboratory signs of myelosuppression or hepatotoxicity
cohort: 13 pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) using thioguanine
finding: Thioguanine use during pregnancy in women with IBD was not associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes or congenital abnormalities in this small case series.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 7 out of 16 ongoing pregnancies.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth: 39 weeks (singleton pregnancies)
